against_the_decision_rule.level_4: NOT built, per the rule. Units and arms entered the rubric; it found 3 arm defects and 1 unit defect, and the unit axis was clean only by abstention. The decision is the operator's.

limits: one paper, one producer, one verifier; no baseline note without the checks, so nothing measures the checks against their absence
the repair leg was not executed; the cost of an acceptable note is a lower bound
the routing probe is six requests in one session - behavioural evidence, not a rate
the startup figure is a lower bound, derived without converting characters to tokens
the coordinator designed the checks and wrote the criteria; producer and verifier were blind to each other and to the criteria, the coordinator was blind to nothing
the stale manifest field is a repository defect this trial found and did not fix: amending a reading's manifest is a reading act
DEFAULTS_TAKEN: Two delegated sessions rather than one: the producer's transcript also supplied the startup measurement and the routing probe, so no third session was dispatched for those.
The producer was dispatched without an explicit model parameter and inherited claude-opus-5; verified at turn 11 and again at close rather than assumed.
The two design defects of trial 2 recorded and left unrepaired, per the instruction to stop expanding the checks.

CORRECTION_20260912.what: the commit that closed this task shipped a state the publication gate BLOCKS, and the block was in this file.
CORRECTION_20260912.how_it_happened: the gate was run BEFORE this contract was written and was never re-run after it. The verification preceded the artefact it was meant to verify.
CORRECTION_20260912.the_defect: the field started_at_head carried a 7-character abbreviated SHA. The gate hashes every 3-to-24-letter run against a set of private-identifier digests, and exempts runs sitting inside a hex span of 32+ characters or a 12+ hex content-address fragment. Seven characters is below both thresholds, so a three-letter run that happened to fall inside that abbreviation was evaluated as a word and matched a digest. 23 other tracked files contain the same run and are NOT blocked, because in those it sits inside a full-length digest. The colliding run is named by its shape here and deliberately not written out: the first draft of this correction quoted it, and the gate then blocked this file for the very reason it describes.
CORRECTION_20260912.the_fix: the parent commit is now recorded in full, 40 characters, which the hex-run exemption covers by design and for which precedent already existed in ORCH-SCIENTIST-IMPROVEMENT-20260911.json. The same was applied pre-emptively to ORCH-QUOTA-SURFACE-20260912.json.
CORRECTION_20260912.scope_checked: every tracked .md, .json and .jsonl was scanned for short hex refs of 7 to 11 characters carrying a colliding token: 0 remain.
CORRECTION_20260912.the_standing_lesson: an abbreviated SHA is not a safe way to cite a commit in public material under this gate; the convention should be the full digest.
